acceptance: Freeze clean source, effective config, observer files and native binary before execution; verify unchanged source and binary after completion.
Require all 224 metrics, including 208 identical non-latency metrics and 146 enforced metrics; no waivers, missing rows or worse values.
Compare every ordered frame identity in all 15 captures (15269 frames). All fields outside declared timing and validated latency-only health effects must match exactly.

Validate reference six-stage sum against its historical total; candidate six-stage sum against stages, and stages+health+result against complete total. Independent 0.01ms rounding gives sum error bounds 0.035ms and 0.020ms.

Recompute health p95 from baseline current-through-last-window stage totals and candidate preceding completed totals. Allow at most 0.055ms from total rounding (0.005ms) plus p95 rounding (0.05ms). First candidate p95 must be zero with empty history.
Require exact previous_complete_process basis and integer sample age 1, except explicit index0 with null. Each eval_real.run_piece owns one detector and has no internal reset; unexpected nulls fail.
Validate exact latency warning grammar, ten-sample warm-up, threshold and derived level before excluding only latency_p95_ms, validated latency text/level and the two declared metadata fields.
Preserve all before/after health differences and contract/semantic failures. Reject unknown health fields rather than silently dropping them.
Set F requires all 30 registered cases and exactly 3060 actual rows in the same order; semantic contents must match exactly except summary.wall_s.
limits: Shared-load timing is diagnostic and cannot establish execution speed, ROS runtime latency or a score increase.
No new history stress is required for this instrumentation-only default-false change; both latency decision policies are covered by focused tests.
The previous full-gate evidence remains unchanged; this candidate gets its own new record.
